method.reference: stats::optim L-BFGS-B (analytic gradient) then Nelder-Mead from seeded starts, lowest -2LL kept; Newton polish at 256 bits (Rmpfr) with active set and KKT test
method.hessian_step: 1e-25 times max(|z_j|, scale_j), central differences of the analytic gradient
method.expected_information: sum_i (u_i u_i' + 2 l_i l_i') on the moved variables, inverse over the free block, delta method to user units (FIT-ML-06, FIT-ML-17)
method.observed_information: half the Hessian of -2LL at 256 bits on the moved variables, inverse over the free block, delta method to user units
method.flip_flop: pk1.oral_1: the point with ka > k is reported (V, k, ka) == (V k / ka, ka, k)
